_doc: Per-string window overrides {addr: {px, dialogue, lines}} for text drawn in a narrower box than its class implies (dialogue = 2-line box, lines 3+ scroll with {FA}). lines = max lines for a box that does not scroll; insert.py reports too_long instead of overflowing it.
